maddeler.e:
أستحوذ (form X)
# أَسْتَحْوِذُ (ʔastaḥwiḏu) /ʔas.taħ.wi.ðu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَحْوَذَ (istaḥwaḏa)
# أَسْتَحْوِذَ (ʔastaḥwiḏa) /ʔas.taħ.wi.ða/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَحْوَذَ (istaḥwaḏa)
# أَسْتَحْوِذْ (ʔastaḥwiḏ) /ʔas.taħ.wið/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَحْوَذَ (istaḥwaḏa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
